basis: Intellectual and speech developmental impairment define the disorder; isolated 1/1 extra-neural reports do not establish involvement in ≥30% of the larger reported cohort.
Inherited dysfunction of circadian sleep timing; no established direct damage to other organs.
Defined by severe T-cell deficiency with markedly reduced circulating T cells, congenital alopecia and nail dystrophy.
Coronavirus infections predominantly arise in the respiratory tract; extrapulmonary complications are not common across the umbrella.
Disordered iron handling causes brain iron accumulation and progressive neurodegeneration; dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction.
Tumour originates in the spinal meninges.
Cerebellar and peripheral nerve degeneration define disease; structural pes cavus occurs in 30–79%. Saccadic abnormalities arise from neurologic dysfunction.
Treponemal infection; early mucocutaneous lesions generally resolve. Destructive neurologic and cardiovascular manifestations are minority, separately classified late forms.
Patellar/skeletal hypoplasia and microtia define Meier-Gorlin syndrome; developmental delay and cleft palate each reported in 1/1 assessed patient, with very limited sampling.
Postsynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder; ocular, bulbar and respiratory manifestations reflect impaired neuromuscular transmission rather than intrinsic organ damage.
HIV-associated infection of renal tissue produces collapsing glomerular and tubular injury.
Gonococcal infection of the cervix; reproductive anatomy has no organ axis, but the infectious mechanism applies.
Disorder directly affecting cranial nerves; specific ocular or auditory involvement is subtype-dependent.
Malignancy arising in or occupying the meninges of the central nervous system.
Vertebral, epiphyseal and metaphyseal dysplasia define disease; hepatosplenomegaly and airway abnormalities occur in only 5–29%, without established common organ dysfunction.
Respiratory malformation umbrella classified under respiratory system disorder; thoracic skeletal involvement cannot be assumed across the group.
Extreme insulin resistance and hyperandrogenism with defining persistent acanthosis nigricans and epidermal hyperplasia.
Hereditary platelet aggregation abnormality; no evidence supplied for common thrombosis or direct injury to another organ.
Inborn serine biosynthesis deficiency defined by microcephaly, neurodevelopmental impairment and seizures.
Skeletal dysplasia with craniosynostosis and defining dental eruption failure/tooth agenesis, reported in 80–99%; teeth belong to gastrointestinal.
Mitochondrial disorder spectrum defined by optic nerve degeneration and/or spastic ataxia; relative frequencies of these defining phenotypes vary by subtype.
Functional disorder of intestinal transit and stool consistency; no established direct extraintestinal organ damage.
Defined by global developmental delay or intellectual disability with autism and behavioural abnormalities.
Congenital neutrophil deficiency causes impaired innate immunity and recurrent infections; additional organ abnormalities vary across syndromic subtypes.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with azoospermia and maturation arrest; reproductive function has no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not established.
